statements.statement: The service billed is CPT 93229 (Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, R00.2, Z86.73
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The patient has recurrent palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The ordered service is intended to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management
The patient is at high risk of thromboembolic events
